sentences.tts: Translators still disagree on how to render it.
Marmaduke Pickthall, in nineteen thirty, wrote many-columned Iram.
A modern translation, Saheeh International, has Iram, who had lofty pillars.
Even the next verse divides them.
Was Iram a place, the like of which was never created?
Or a people, the likes of whom?
